title: fsim mission-training documents, version 1
$comment: Frozen by generic M0 (docs/sdk/mission-training.md). A local SDK contract, not an ASK/UCI wire format. The dialect is JSON Schema 2020-12, restricted to the keywords tools/validation/ma_contract/check.py lists; the SDK itself needs no schema library. Rules a schema cannot state (decoded base64 length, request-id order, cross references, limits a configuration sets) are in mission-training.md and checked by tools/validation/ma_contract/check.py.

u64.$comment: A 64-bit identity or correlation: unsigned decimal, no sign, no leading zero, at most 18446744073709551615.

u32.$comment: A 32-bit identity (entity, controller, system, net, topic, designation, package, role): unsigned decimal string, at most 4294967295.

u16.$comment: A payload index: unsigned decimal string, at most 65535.

number_or_null.$comment: A reported quantity, or null where the bound Agent does not know it (a native NaN, a value not measured, a report not held). Never NaN, never a substitute zero.

native_name.$comment: A name the SDK's own name function gives (reasonName, activityStateName, familyName ...): transported, not redefined here.

base64.$comment: RFC 4648 section 4: the standard alphabet, padded, no line breaks, canonical (unused bits zero). At most 65536 decoded bytes in any document; a configuration's max_message_bytes and each net's own limit are lower.

extensions.$comment: The integration seam for frozen extension definitions, each in a file of its own: a key is its registered schema reference (<family>.<name>.v<N>), its value that definition's document. A reference no handler registered fails explicitly (unsupported_extension).

meta.$comment: Where a report came from and how old it is. Times are simulation seconds; null where the source gives none.

scenario.$comment: An existing scenario document (fsim/Scenario.h, docs/sdk/scenarios.md), in that format's own units. Its world section may name the world and its data only: timing, seed, workers, publication and recording are this configuration's.

spec.$comment: comm::NetSpec; a field left out keeps its native default.

items.$comment: comm::DisseminationPlan; a period of 0 publishes nothing; a field left out keeps its native default.
comm::RbacConfig's roles for one platform; a platform not listed keeps the native A-GRA defaults. Its strike policy is not generic configuration.

reports.$comment: stale_after_s: a held report whose age_s is above it is marked stale. Left out: nothing is.

execution.$comment: Defaults: workers 1, diagnostic false, publish false, no recording. publish true or a record_dir requires diagnostic true: such an episode is labelled non-isolated.

service_binding.$comment: MAServiceBindingV1 as a document: its controller is minted by the range when the episode makes the service's Agent, never named here.

own_ship.$comment: fsim::OwnShip, as the platform's navigation and air data report it. null for a C2 node or a platform no longer alive.

endurance.$comment: control::NavigationReport. A native infinite endurance or playtime is null with its *_unbounded flag true.

items.$comment: One command capability of the bound platform: a VI capability (control::CapabilityDescriptor, CapabilityStatus, ControlStatus) or an MS capability instance (ms::CapabilityInfo, CapabilityStatus). owner_service_id: the configured service it is bound to; null: none.
ms::PayloadInfo, and for an air radar a part of ms::RadarStatus.
ms::AmtiTrack of the bound platform's own radar, without the entity behind it.
ms::Contact of the bound platform's own passive or mapping sensors, without the entity behind it.
comm::LinkTrack: a track received over a link, as its source system's report said when it arrived.
comm::PeerReport: a peer's last position report and heartbeat, as they arrived.
fsim::Designation: the bound platform's own target designation, by track. source_system_id null: its own radar's track.

control::ActivityRecord (domain vi) or ms::ActivityRecord (domain ms) of the bound platform. owner_service_id null: not made through a configured service's request (C2's direct command, the platform's own).
comm::DmsTransmission of a send this service's request made and its receipt still holds.

authority_report.$comment: fsim::C2Authority: the authority over the bound platform, as its MA core keeps it.

task_order.$comment: comm::TaskOrder. A target is a network track - its source system, radar and number - never an entity.

items.$comment: comm::ReceivedTask: a C2 task as the MA holds it.
comm::CommandStatusEntry: the last status an MA answered for a C2 command this system sent. A role declaration's answer carries command id 0.

collection_messages.$comment: What reached the bound system's DMS since the previous decision tick's snapshot, ingested once by the gateway. dropped: messages the native inbox let go before ingestion is not known to an agent and is not reported.

component.$comment: Upper-layer provenance, echoed in the receipt. Never read for authorization: the service is the endpoint's.

request_gateway.$comment: The transport's own: close stops following an earlier request of this service. It commands nothing natively - what that request started goes on under native semantics.

items.$comment: A part of control::Waypoint; every other native field is left out (kHold, a fly-by turn).

parameters.$comment: ms::AmtiCommand without its illumination, which is not a generic operation. A field left out keeps its native default.
comm::DmsMessage. No destinations: published. topic at least 1000 (comm::topic::kFreeForm); a native type's topic is refused natively.
state accepted: progress; completed or failed: its end. percent left out or null: the native NaN (none).
The six fields a C2 direct command carries (comm::FlightCommand); one left out is the native kHold.
comm::TaskOrder; its task id is the sender's MA core's, returned in the receipt. A field left out or null is the native NaN (not given).
comm::OverrideCommand. cancel true clears the override of that kind; otherwise its value is required. expiry_s left out or null: until canceled.

receipt.$comment: One request's standing. state says what the transport and the native call did - never that a mission succeeded. closed: the gateway follows it no longer; it is kept for the configured retention ticks, then forgotten.

native.$comment: The native answer, transported: null until the request is dispatched, or where the gateway refused it.

submission.$comment: The acknowledgment of this endpoint's latest submit in the current generation: null before the first. A document the gateway refused as a whole queued nothing.

outcome.$comment: The referee's: never part of an actor's observation, mask or infos.

truth.$comment: The referee's truth, for a reward or a centralised critic: never part of an actor's observation, mask or infos.

state.$comment: A part of fsim::VehicleState (truth). null for a C2 node, whose position is its specification's.
